subject.title: [Feature]: Surface delivery correlation data on message_sent hooks

question: Should deliveryId and attemptNumber describe only durable queued deliveries, or should every outbound dispatch receive a logical identity even when it bypasses the queue?
rationale: That choice defines the long-term plugin API contract and affects direct-send semantics, persistence, retry meaning, and future compatibility; source inspection cannot determine maintainer intent.

options.title: Queue-backed identity first
options.body: Expose optional deliveryId and attemptNumber only when durable queue state exists, while adding receipt and runId wherever available.

options.title: Universal dispatch identity
options.body: Create a logical delivery identity and attempt semantics for every outbound path before exposing the new hook fields.

recommendation.title: Queue-backed identity first
recommendation.body: Expose optional deliveryId and attemptNumber only when durable queue state exists, while adding receipt and runId wherever available.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the outbound delivery path makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the identity-semantics decision.
